findings.title: getJson fetch has no timeout and swallows all errors
findings.note: fetch call sets no AbortSignal/timeout, so a non-responding remote hangs the await indefinitely; the sibling client-admin.ts uses AbortSignal.timeout(5000) for the same pattern, and the catch block here is also empty, silently discarding failures.

findings.title: Bulk pricing test skipped; feature never implemented in priceOf
findings.note: priceOf has no bulk-discount logic at all (flat PRICES lookup), so the skipped test documents a requirement that was never built, not a currently-flaky test; no ticket or date is attached to the skip.

findings.title: Deprecated legacyFormat still used on the live checkout path
findings.note: Marker is 704 days old with no ticket reference; the deprecated function is still exercised whenever the newCheckout flag is off, so the replacement migration was never finished.

looks_bad_but_fine.why: Has AbortSignal.timeout(5000) and logs errors in the catch block, so it is not half-finished despite superficially resembling client.ts.

not_assessed: Whether format-legacy.ts's @deprecated marker corresponds to a tracked ticket (SATD list marks ticket=False, but no ticket system was inspected)
